تستلمون (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِمُونَ (tastalimūna) /tas.ta.li.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# تُسْتَلَمُونَ (tustalamūna) /tus.ta.la.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
